settings.name: N_ADAPT
settings.description: Number of warm-up iterations per chain, used to tune the sampler before draws are kept.

settings.name: N_DRAWS
settings.description: Posterior draws kept per chain after warm-up. More draws give smoother intervals but longer runs.

settings.name: RETRY_N_ADAPT
settings.description: Warm-up iterations per chain of the rerun that follows a failed convergence check; it adapts again from scratch.

settings.name: RETRY_N_DRAWS
settings.description: Draws kept per chain after the warm-up of the rerun.

settings.name: RNG_SEED
settings.description: Seed of every random draw. The same seed reproduces a run exactly.

settings.name: TARGET_ACCEPT
settings.description: Target acceptance rate of the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS), in percent. Higher means smaller steps, fewer divergent transitions and more leapfrog steps. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: N_CHAINS
settings.description: Number of independent chains. Chains 1 and 2 start at the maximum a posteriori (MAP) point; the others start in mirrored pairs.

settings.name: CHAIN_START_RADII
settings.description: Start distances, in standard deviations, from the MAP point of mirrored chain pairs (±r). Far starts find second modes. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: OPTIMUM_CHAIN_CAP
settings.description: Cap on the number of extra chains started at optima. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: OPTIMUM_MIN_CHAINS
settings.description: Minimum number of chains each massive optimum (at least 1 % Laplace mass) should have; missing chains are started there.

settings.name: OPTIMUM_CHAIN_RADIUS
settings.description: Mahalanobis radius around an optimum within which a draw counts as being at it. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: OPTIMUM_CHAIN_FRACTION
settings.description: Share of a chain's draws that must lie within the radius for the chain to count as at the optimum. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: MAP_MAX_ITER
settings.description: Maximum number of L-BFGS optimizer steps per start. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: MAP_N_STARTS
settings.description: Number of L-BFGS starts of the search for the posterior mode. More starts miss fewer basins but run slower. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: MAP_F_SUCCESSIVE
settings.description: Stop a start when −log π (the negative log posterior) improves by less than 1e-6 nats for this many iterations in a row. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: MAP_OPTIMA_KEPT
settings.description: Of the optima found, keep the best N (lowest −log π) and compare them by Laplace mass to choose the whitening point. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: MAP_JITTER_RADII
settings.description: Distances, in standard deviations, from an optimum at which its extra L-BFGS restarts begin. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: MAP_JITTER_DIRECTIONS
settings.description: Random directions tried at each jitter radius. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: MAP_JITTER_MAX_OPTIMA
settings.description: Jitter only the best N optima (lowest −log π). Not recommended to change.

settings.name: MAP_JITTER_WITHIN_NATS
settings.description: Only optima within this many nats of the lowest are jittered. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: BASIN_RESTART_NATS
settings.description: If a draw beats the maximum a posteriori (MAP) point by more than this many nats, a better basin was missed: re-whiten there and rerun the chain. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: HARVEST_COVER
settings.description: After the first round, run L-BFGS from this many draws to find missed optima. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: HARVEST_DIVERGENT
settings.description: Also run L-BFGS from at most this many divergent draws. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: Q_MIN
settings.description: Lowest q fitted, in Å⁻¹; points below it are left out. none uses every point.

settings.name: Q_MAX
settings.description: Highest q fitted, in Å⁻¹; points above it are left out. none uses every point. Must lie above Q_MIN.

settings.name: SIGMA_SCALE
settings.description: Factor the measured standard errors are multiplied by: above 1 says they were under-estimated, below 1 over-estimated.

settings.name: EXCLUDE_Q
settings.description: Ranges of q, in Å⁻¹, whose points are left out, typed as lo-hi pairs such as 0.1-0.2, 0.5-0.6. none leaves none out.

settings.name: CHAINS
settings.description: The chains of the structure that are kept, one character each, as in the file (case counts), such as A B. all keeps every chain.

settings.name: MODEL
settings.description: Which model of a multi-model structure (an NMR ensemble) is used, counting from 1.

settings.name: ADD_HYDROGENS
settings.description: Whether hydrogens are added (PROPKA and pdb2pqr); no fits the structure as it is, with the hydrogens it carries.

settings.name: BOUNDS_δρ₁₂
settings.description: Hard limits (low, high) on the hydration-shell contrasts δρ₁ and δρ₂, in CRYSOL's units.

settings.name: MODE_δρ₁₂
settings.description: Most likely value of δρ₁ and δρ₂ (CRYSOL's default is 1). Must lie inside the bounds.

settings.name: κ_δρ₁₂
settings.description: Concentration of the δρ₁ and δρ₂ Beta priors. Higher is tighter; 14 gives a standard deviation of about 1.

settings.name: κ_δρ₃
settings.description: Concentration of the Beta prior of the cavity contrast δρ₃, whose mode is bulk-density water.

settings.name: φ_max
settings.description: Maximum cavity water density relative to bulk; it bounds δρ₃. 1.25 is above the densest hydration water.

settings.name: EXCL_VOL_CORR_BOUNDS
settings.description: Hard limits (low, high) on the excluded-volume correction c1. Hitting a bound is intended: c1 cannot absorb model misspecification.

settings.name: EXCL_VOL_CORR_EPS
settings.description: Padding of the search range of the excluded-volume correction c1, and step of the coarse scan. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: PMV_FALLBACK_UNCERT
settings.description: Fallback PMV uncertainty. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: SHELL_THICKNESS
settings.description: Hydration-shell thickness beyond the accessible surface (CRYSOL's default).

settings.name: PROBE_RADIUS
settings.description: Solvent probe radius used for the accessible surface (water).

settings.name: SHELL_AREA_PER_POINT
settings.description: Square ångströms of surface per shell point; sets the point spacing, calibrated to CRYSOL. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: SHELL_MIN_POINTS
settings.description: Floor on the number of shell points (CRYSOL's smallest grid, F(10)). Not recommended to change.

settings.name: SHELL_SAMPLE
settings.description: Sample directions per atom for the surface. More is slower and more accurate. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: SASA_N_OCC
settings.description: Early-exit prefix of the surface directions; smaller is faster but loses solvent-accessible area (0.3 to 0.6 % at 104). Not recommended to change.

settings.name: BEAD_RAY_RANGE
settings.description: Range of the rays that classify a bead as cavity or bulk; a farther wall counts as bulk. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: BEAD_RAY_DIRS
settings.description: Number of ray directions per bead for that test. Not recommended to change.

settings.name: LMAX
settings.description: Spherical-harmonic band limit of the forward model. auto takes q_max times the diameter of the scatterer cloud; lower is coarser and faster.

settings.name: TABLE_SIGFIGS
settings.description: Significant figures of each workbook number. 17 keeps every bit of a 64-bit float; 15 is the most that is guaranteed.

settings.name: VAL_SIGMA
settings.description: Half-width, in standard deviations, of the reported interval (2 gives 2.28 % to 97.72 %). Not advised above 3: too few draws.

settings.name: FIGURES_TEX
settings.description: Write each figure as a pgfplots .tex file in the plots folder. No LaTeX installation is needed.

settings.name: FIGURES_FORMATS
settings.description: File types made from each .tex file when compiling: :pdf, :png or :svg (PNG and SVG also need poppler).

settings.name: FIGURES_DIR
settings.description: Plot dir: where plots are moved and compiled to, one folder for all projects (<plot dir>/<project>/<run>/<model>/). Empty: the plots folder of the BAYSOL data folder. A run also copies its .tex figures there when this is set.

settings.name: FIGURES_COMPILER
settings.description: Path of the LaTeX compiler that compiles plots (lualatex, xelatex or pdflatex, named by its file). Empty: lualatex, then xelatex, found on the PATH. A path that is set is never replaced by another compiler.

settings.name: PLOT_COLOUR_MAP
settings.description: Colour of the maximum a posteriori (MAP) curve and of its markers in the histograms.

settings.name: PLOT_COLOUR_POSTERIOR
settings.description: Colour of the posterior quantile curves.

settings.name: PLOT_COLOUR_DATA
settings.description: Colour of the measured points.

settings.name: PLOT_COLOUR_ERRORBAR
settings.description: Colour and opacity of the error bars of the measured points.

settings.name: PLOT_COLOUR_REFERENCE
settings.description: Colour of the reference curve on a comparison plot.

settings.name: PLOT_COLOUR_BAND
settings.description: Colour and opacity of the posterior bounds band of the intensity plot.

settings.name: PLOT_COLOUR_BAND_RESID
settings.description: Colour and opacity of the posterior bounds band of the residuals plot.

settings.name: PLOT_COLOUR_HIST
settings.description: Colour and opacity of the histogram bars.

settings.name: PLOT_COLOUR_AXIS
settings.description: Colour of the axes.

settings.name: PLOT_TICK_COLOUR
settings.description: Colour of the ticks.

settings.name: PLOT_LW_MAP
settings.description: Line width, in points, of the MAP curve and of its histogram marker.

settings.name: PLOT_LW_REFERENCE
settings.description: Line width, in points, of the reference curve.

settings.name: PLOT_LW_QUANTILE
settings.description: Line width, in points, of the quantile curves of the intensity plot.

settings.name: PLOT_LW_QUANTILE_RESID
settings.description: Line width, in points, of the quantile curves of the residuals plot.

settings.name: PLOT_LW_ZERO_LINE
settings.description: Line width, in points, of the zero line of the residuals plot.

settings.name: PLOT_LW_ERRORBAR
settings.description: Width, in points, of the error bars.

settings.name: PLOT_AXIS_LW
settings.description: Line width, in points, of the axes.

settings.name: PLOT_LW_MAJOR_TICK
settings.description: Width, in points, of the major ticks.

settings.name: PLOT_LW_MINOR_TICK
settings.description: Width, in points, of the minor ticks.

settings.name: PLOT_MARKERSIZE
settings.description: Radius, in points, of the data markers.

settings.name: PLOT_WHISKERWIDTH
settings.description: Length, in points, of the end caps (whiskers) of the error bars.

settings.name: PLOT_COMPARE
settings.description: Whether a run makes the comparison figure and workbook: the measured curve, every model and the reference curves on one plot.

settings.name: PLOT_COMPARE_COLOURS
settings.description: Colours of the fitted curves of the comparison figure, in order, one per model, repeating when there are more models.

settings.name: PLOT_COMPARE_MARKERS
settings.description: Markers of the reference curves of the comparison figure, in order, repeating when there are more references.

settings.name: PLOT_LW_COMPARE
settings.description: Line width, in points, of the fitted curves of the comparison figure.

settings.name: PLOT_WIDTH_HEIGHT_CM
settings.description: Width and height of the figures, in centimetres.

settings.name: PLOT_PREVIEW_SIZE
settings.description: Width (in characters) and height (in rows) of a plot previewed in the terminal.

settings.name: PLOT_TUI_SIZES
settings.description: Sizes, width x height in characters, of the terminal plots a run writes, growing in both; the viewer shows the largest that fits its window.

settings.name: PLOT_BORDER_PT
settings.description: Padding added around the plot when exporting. Without it the page is cropped to the bounding box, which can cut off labels or tick marks.

settings.name: PLOT_TEXT_FONT
settings.description: Text font of the figures.

settings.name: PLOT_MATH_FONT
settings.description: Math font of the figures.

settings.name: PLOT_HIST_BINS
settings.description: Number of bins of each posterior histogram.

settings.name: PLOT_YLIM_LOG
settings.description: The y-range of the intensity plots is the data's range scaled by these two factors (lower, upper).

settings.name: PLOT_YLIM_LIN_PAD_FRAC
settings.description: Padding of the y-range of the residuals plot, as a fraction of the residuals' range.

settings.name: PLOT_TICK_LENGTH_CM
settings.description: Length, in centimetres, of the major ticks; minor ticks are half as long.

settings.name: PLOT_LINMIN_TICKS
settings.description: Number of minor ticks between major ticks on linear axes.

settings.name: PLOT_XTICK_ANGLE
settings.description: Counter-clockwise angle, in degrees, of the x-tick elbows.

settings.name: PLOT_XTICK_STUB_PT
settings.description: Length, in points, of the x-tick stubs.

settings.name: PLOT_XTICK_ELBOW_PT
settings.description: Length, in points, of the x-tick elbows.

settings.name: PLOT_XTICK_LABEL_PAD_PT
settings.description: Gap, in points, between the axis and the x-tick labels.

settings.name: PLOT_YTICK_LABEL_PAD_PT
settings.description: Gap, in points, between the axis and the y-tick labels.
